evidence.V1: Instantly reads as a spotted toadstool from front, three-quarter and silhouette; top view is a spotted red disc that still reads as a mushroom cap at 64 px.
evidence.V2: Clear hierarchy: big domed cap, medium stem plus the smaller child mushroom, small cream spots and rim band.
evidence.V3: Cap dome and rim band are nicely stylised, but the main stem is a straight, uniform thin cylinder and the child sits stiffly against it; only partly exaggerated.
evidence.V4: Cap dome is soft and the rim band reads well, but the stem foot flare and the spots have polygonal faceted outlines and the cap underside edge is a sawtooth - inconsistent edge treatment.
evidence.V5: Front view shows a jagged sawtooth fringe under the cap rim; spot discs and stem foot flares show visible low-segment faceting in the close-ups (minor, but visible).
evidence.V6: Disciplined: cap hue in two values (dome + lighter rim band) and cream spots/stem; teal and ember colourways keep the same structure.
evidence.V7: 1760 tris vs tree target 2000 (ceiling 5000) - under target.
evidence.V8: One white LF_VertexColor material, warm cream stem/spots match the kit, but spots are low-segment stuck-on shells and the faceted foot/underside fall short of the fused smooth organic shell standard.
evidence.V9: Static scenery Studio line correct: Anchored, Hull collision, CanTouch off, MeshPart white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre.
